entries.name: BThwani Contextual CI
entries.purpose: Root exact-SHA orchestrator that calculates affected and risk-expanded scope, invokes reusable verification engines, and enforces one fail-closed result.

entries.name: BThwani Policy Verification
entries.purpose: Reusable repository, governance, workflow, security, nomenclature, and infrastructure policy verification engine.

entries.name: BThwani Node Diagnostics
entries.purpose: Reusable affected static diagnostics for boundaries, bindings, accessibility, dependency direction, dead code, duplication, and repository integrity.

entries.name: BThwani Node Verification
entries.purpose: Reusable affected or full typecheck, lint, test, build, contract, and governed capability verification engine.

entries.name: BThwani Backend Verification
entries.purpose: Reusable affected Go backend and isolated PostgreSQL migration, test, vet, and build verification engine.

entries.name: BThwani Runtime Proof
entries.purpose: Reusable runtime startup, bootstrap, readiness, smoke, and teardown proof when the router or explicit request requires runtime evidence.

entries.name: DSH Database Contract
entries.purpose: Manual closure-only DSH database contract verification for the canonical migrations, schema, seeds, and contract against an isolated PostgreSQL service; contextual CI owns affected database routing.

entries.name: BThwani Lockfile Integrity
entries.purpose: Read-only frozen-lockfile verification for dependency manifest changes; it never generates or uploads a replacement tracked lockfile.

entries.name: BThwani Manual Deep Verification
entries.purpose: Read-only exact-SHA affected and risk-expanded manual verification with optional full runtime proof and a machine-readable decision artifact.

entries.name: CodeQL
entries.purpose: Context-routed static application and workflow security testing for GitHub Actions, javascript-typescript, and affected Go backend modules, using security-extended queries. Workflow changes and protected-branch or scheduled runs remain full scans; the fail-closed CodeQL result aggregate is the merge context.

entries.name: Dependency Review
entries.purpose: Fail-closed pull-request supply-chain gate that blocks introduction of known vulnerable dependencies at LOW severity or higher and exposes a deterministic protected-branch check context.

entries.name: SonarQube
entries.purpose: Code quality and security analysis published to SonarQube Cloud; pull requests generate Go coverage only for affected modules while protected master pushes retain the full Go coverage baseline.
entries.secretsJustification: SonarQube authenticates uploads with SONAR_TOKEN; the scanner cannot publish without it. The token is scoped to the SonarQube Cloud scanner and grants no repository write access.
